# Add two-stage optimization pipeline: simulated annealing + hill climbing

The INIT set alone (gamma≈0.910) is suboptimal because no search has been applied. Simulated annealing with temperature decay explores the configuration space to escape local optima and find regions with better sums/differences ratios. Hill climbing then refines the best solution found. This pipeline is proven effective for combinatorial optimization and should significantly improve gamma with available runtime budget (30s vs current 0.022s).
